postconditions.description: The input root is a valid TreeNode object or None.

postconditions.expression: root is None or (root.left is None and root.right is None) or (root.left is not None and root.right is not None)
postconditions.description: The input root is a leaf node or an internal node with both left and right children.

invariants.expression: all(node.val is not None for node in self.traverse_nodes(root))
invariants.description: All nodes in the tree have non-None values.
